objectives.statement: Recognize common Bokmål words written with kj, sj, and skj.
Tell the kj spelling group from the sj and skj spelling groups in high-value words.
Choose and place the correct spelling in short everyday sentences.

notes: Must teach spelling/sound awareness for kj versus sj/skj in Bokmål. Keep scope to recognition and high-value examples; do not claim text-only drills replace audio practice.
